rows.ja: 資産の売却・ストリーム

companies.name: オレゾーン・ゴールド

relations.text: カサ・ベラルディ鉱山を最大5.93億ドルでOrezoneに売却する契約
relations.text_en: Agreed to sell the Casa Berardi operation to Orezone for up to $593 million

source.label: Hecla Mining 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have entered into an agreement to sell our Casa Berardi operation to Orezone for total consideration of up to $593 million

companies.name: フランコ・ネバダ
companies.sub: ロイヤルティ・ストリーム

relations.text: OrezoneのHecla資産買収をストリーム契約で支える
relations.text_en: Its stream funds Orezone's purchase of Hecla's Casa Berardi mine

source.label: Franco-Nevada 年次情報(40-F添付)
source.quote: The stream transaction will support Orezone's acquisition of Hecla Mining Company's (" Hecla ") producing Casa Berardi gold mine

companies.name: ウィートン・プレシャス・メタルズ

relations.text: Alexco買収に伴い、ストリーム契約の解約対価としてHecla株1.35億ドル分を受け取った
relations.text_en: Took $135 million of Hecla stock to end its Alexco stream when Hecla bought Alexco

source.label: Wheaton Precious Metals 年次情報(40-F添付)
source.label_en: Wheaton Precious Metals annual information form (40-F exhibit)
source.quote: On September 7, 2022, Hecla completed its acquisition of all the outstanding common shares of Alexco and the Company received $135 million of Hecla common stock for the termination of the Alexco PMPA.

companies.name: アレクスコ・リソース

relations.text: ユーコンのKeno Hillを持つAlexcoを買収(2022年9月)
relations.text_en: Acquired Alexco, owner of Keno Hill in the Yukon (September 2022)

source.label: Wheaton Precious Metals 年次情報(40-F添付)
source.label_en: Wheaton Precious Metals annual information form (40-F exhibit)
source.quote: On September 7, 2022, Hecla completed its acquisition of all the outstanding common shares of Alexco

companies.name: クロンデックス・マインズ

relations.text: ネバダの金鉱会社Klondexを買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the Nevada gold miner Klondex

source.label: Aqua Metals 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Before its acquisition by Hecla, Klondex was a $500 million dollar company traded on the New York Stock Exchange and the Toronto Stock Exchange.

companies.name: パーペチュア・リソーシズ

relations.text: Stibnite計画の一部の地表権をHeclaが持ち、Perpetuaが取得を検討
relations.text_en: Considering buying surface rights Hecla holds within its Stibnite project

source.label: Perpetua Resources 技術報告書(10-K添付)
source.quote: Perpetua Resources is exploring alternatives with respect to these partial millsites, which may include acquiring such property from Hecla.

companies.name: ヴィクトリア・ゴールド

relations.text: 近隣のEagle鉱山の事故(2024年6月)で、Keno Hillの選鉱を停止せざるを得なかった
relations.text_en: Its Eagle Mine heap leach failure (June 2024) forced Hecla to halt milling at Keno Hill

source.label: Hecla Mining 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In late June 2024, an unrelated, third party, Victoria Gold, experienced a heap leach failure at its Eagle Mine which is located near Keno Hill.
